title: Deterministic policy replay + decision explainability for autoscaler
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build a deterministic replay and explainability layer for the autoscaling policy engine so every scale decision (including shadow/rollback decisions) can be reproduced offline, audited for compliance, and surfaced with human-readable reasoning in the Console. This ticket focuses on the decision-record format, deterministic replay harness, a lightweight decision-explainer that computes causal contributors, and the integration points required to store and query decision records from the control-plane audit store.

Scope:
- Canonical decision record schema for all autoscaler policy types (reactive thresholds, PID, proportional, headroom-crediting, predictive warmup). Schema must include inputs (timestamped metric window snapshots), policy parameters, intermediate signals (e.g., smoothed percentiles, predicted demand), random seeds or nondeterministic sources, and the final action and rationale.
- Deterministic replay harness that can take a decision record and reproduce the exact scaling action given the same recorded inputs. Replay must be robust to innocuous external diffs (agent clock skew, minor telemetry delays) and should flag reproducibility drift.
- Explainability module that generates a short (1-3 sentence) human-readable explanation plus a ranked list of numeric contributors (e.g., p95 latency + backlog tokens/sec + headroom credit) with percent influence. These outputs must be stored with the record and surfaced in the Console.
- Offline simulation runner that can execute a sequence of recorded inputs (or synthetic workload traces) and compare decisions between policy versions (A/B) to compute delta metrics (scale count, max surge, SLA misses avoided, cost delta).
- Integration with existing telemetry (metrics exporter) and audit store (control-plane event log) with retention tags to allow compliance export.
- Shadow-mode/rollout support: ability to run a new policy in shadow and attach a separate decision trace without affecting live scaling.

Non-goals: policy tuning algorithms themselves (we rely on upstream policy implementations), large-scale long-term storage design (we will use existing audit store quotas and retention), UI redesign beyond adding a Console panel for single-decision inspection.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical decision record schema approved by PM and Security (schema doc link included in comments)
Replay harness reproduces recorded scale actions for 95% of sampled production records in a pilot (replay divergence <= 1 scale unit or flagged) and logs deterministic flags for the remainder
Explainability output attached to every recorded decision: short text explanation + top-5 numeric contributors; visible in Console decision inspector
Offline simulation runner can compare two policy versions for a 30-minute production trace and produce a delta report within 2 minutes for 100k events
Shadow-mode preserves live behavior and creates separate decision records without affecting live autoscaler metrics
Security review sign-off for audit storage fields and PII-free record content (security_review_required=true)
End-to-end integration test and one canary rollout plan documented and dry-run executed in staging
tasks: Design decision record schema and get signoff (owner: Arjun)
Implement decision serializer + deterministic seed capture in policy runtime
Build replay harness (CLI + internal service callable) and automated replay tests
Implement explainability module + lightweight scoring heuristics
Integrate decision writes into control-plane audit store (use existing audit API) and add RBAC tags
Add Console Decision Inspector UI entry point (small panel) and backend endpoint
Write E2E tests & performance benchmarks for simulation runner
Run pilot on 3 tenants and collect replay divergence metrics
Prepare rollout runbook (shadow -> staged -> canary -> GA)
